title: Colony Formation Unit Assay
author: NUS iGEM
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8bkhskw

steps.title: Dilute cell culture
steps.instruction: Dilute the cell culture with 1× PBS to obtain three suspensions with final concentrations of 10⁶, 10⁷, and 10⁸ cells per milliliter.

steps.title: Prepare LB agar plates
steps.instruction: Prepare LB agar plates containing the appropriate antibiotic according to the NUS iGEM LB agar preparation protocol.

steps.title: Spot samples onto agar
steps.instruction: Aliquot 40 µL of each diluted sample onto the surface of the prepared agar plate.

steps.title: Incubate plates
steps.instruction: Incubate the inoculated agar plates at 37 °C for overnight (≈16–18 h).
